name: TuringSketch
tagline: A drawing game where players and an AI sketch the same prompts and others guess which drawing is the machine's.
problem: The Turing test is abstract; the team wanted a fun visual version.
solution: Players draw prompts in 30 seconds while an AI draws too; everyone guesses which drawings are human.
demo_moment: Team-described: spot the AI's sketch among the players'.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Streamlit” among 134 submissions.
Turns a classic AI concept into a party game.

lessons: A famous idea made playable is an instant hook.
